gloss: at a loose end; with nothing to do; idle

definitions.gloss: at a loose end; having nothing to do; idle and bored
definitions.explanation: Describes someone who has nothing to occupy them and does not quite know what to do with themselves, often while waiting or when left out. A somewhat literary word, common in fiction.

examples.english: To gaze idly out of the window.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{駅|えき}→駅：02180_eki⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{所在|しょざい}なさそう⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{立|た}っていた→立つ：00758_tatsu⟧。
examples.english: He was standing at the station, looking as if he had nothing to do.

examples.japanese: ⟦{会議|かいぎ}→会議：00710_kaigi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{始|はじ}まる→始まる：00841_hajimaru⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧、{所在|しょざい}ない⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦スマホ→スマホ：04721_sumaho⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{過|す}ごした→過ごす：02062_sugosu⟧。
examples.english: Until the meeting started, I killed the idle time on my phone.

notes:
Built from ⟦{所在|しょざい}→所在：12749_shozai⟧ (whereabouts, something to be doing) + ⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧. Most often met as the adverb {所在|しょざい}なく or in the looks-like forms {所在|しょざい}なげ and {所在|しょざい}なさそう.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {所在|しょざい}なく⟦{待|ま}つ→待つ：00469_matsu⟧: to wait with nothing to do
- {所在|しょざい}なげ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{座|すわ}る→座る：00757_suwaru⟧: to sit there looking at a loose end
- ⟦{所在|しょざい}→所在：12749_shozai⟧なさ: idleness, the feeling of having nothing to do

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{手持|ても}ち{無沙汰|ぶさた}→手持ち無沙汰：15105_temochibusata⟧: having nothing to do with one's hands — more everyday, often about an awkward pause
- ⟦{退屈|たいくつ}→退屈：03389_taikutsu⟧: bored — the plain word for boredom; {所在|しょざい}ない stresses not knowing what to do with oneself
